title: An eye from two arcs
description: Show an eye drawn as two compass arcs that meet at two corners X and Y.

title: Where is the centre?
labels: Same distance from X and Y?
description: An upper eye arc from X to Y, with a guessed centre below XY joined to X and Y by two equal dashed lines and a question mark.

title: Finding the centres A and B
description: Show equal arcs from X and Y meeting at A above XY and B below, and the eye drawn from A and B.

title: Why AB bisects XY at a right angle
description: Show the kite AXBY with diagonal AB meeting XY at O, the equal sides marked, and the right angle at O.

title: All equal points lie on AB
description: Segment XY with its vertical perpendicular bisector carrying points A, C above and B, D below, and equal dashed lines from C to X and Y.

title: One line of equal points
labels: Equally far from X and Y
description: Four green arc crossing points, two above and two below XY, all lined up on one dashed vertical line through the midpoint of XY.

title: Constructing the perpendicular bisector
description: Show the finished construction of the perpendicular bisector of XY, with both pairs of arcs.

title: Choose a big enough radius
description: Two panels: on the left short arcs from X and Y that never meet, on the right longer equal arcs that meet at A and B with the bisector drawn through them.

topic_name: A Right Angle at a Point on a Line
title: A right angle at a point O
description: Show the construction of a 90° angle at a point O on a line.

topic_name: A Right Angle at a Point on a Line
title: A right angle near the end
description: A slanting line with O near its lower end, a small arc giving X and Y, two equal arcs crossing at A and a reddish purple line OA at 90°.

title: Bisecting an angle
description: Show the construction that bisects an angle XOY, with the equal lengths marked.

title: Eight lines, eight 45° angles
description: Show four straight lines through one centre, making eight equal angles of 45°.

title: Halve, then halve again
description: A right angle at O with a teal 45° bisector and a reddish purple ray halving the lower part again into 22.5°, with grey construction arcs.

title: Copying an angle
description: Show an angle at A and its copy at X, built with the same compass settings.

title: Copy in any direction
description: An angle at A opening right and its copy at X turned to open down and left, each with a grey arc and an equal amber dashed chord.

topic_name: A Line Parallel to a Given Line
title: A parallel line through B
description: Show a line through B parallel to m, made by copying the corresponding angle at A.

topic_name: A Line Parallel to a Given Line
title: A parallel line, tilted
description: A steep line m, a transversal l through B, matching grey arcs and amber chords at A and B, and a reddish purple line n through B parallel to m.

topic_name: A Regular Hexagon from Six Triangles
title: Six equilateral triangles make a hexagon
description: Show six equilateral triangles meeting at a point and forming a regular hexagon.

topic_name: A Regular Hexagon from Six Triangles
title: Will the 70° piece fit?
description: Show six angles round a point, with one gap left, and a separate 70° wedge to test.

topic_name: A Regular Hexagon from Six Triangles
title: Three 60° angles make a line
description: A regular hexagon split into six triangles, with the three upper triangles shaded, three 60° angles at O and the line AOD in reddish purple.

topic_name: A Regular Hexagon from Six Triangles
title: Find the gap round a point
description: Three coloured angle wedges of 110°, 90° and 75° round a point O, with the remaining 85° gap highlighted and the equation 360° − 275° = 85° beside it.

title: Constructing a 60° angle
description: Show two equal arcs making an equilateral triangle ABC, and the 60° angle at A.

title: A regular hexagon of side 4 cm
description: Show a regular hexagon drawn by stepping the side length six times round a circle of the same radius.

title: 60°, 120° and the hexagon
description: Three small finished constructions in a row: a 60° angle from two equal grey arcs, a 120° angle made of two 60° angles, and a regular hexagon inside a circle with six arc cuts.

title: Halving 60° to get 30° and 15°
description: A finished compass construction at A: a large grey arc through B, E and C, bisecting arcs meeting at D and F, with reddish purple rays AD at 30° and AF at 15° above AB.

title: The six-pointed star
description: Show a regular hexagon GHIJKL with its sides extended to form a six-pointed star.

title: A perpendicular from a point outside a line
description: Show the construction of the perpendicular from a point P to a line, using one arc and then two equal arcs.

title: A 4 × 6 grid tiled with 2 × 1 tiles
description: Show a 4 × 6 grid fully covered by vertical 2 × 1 tiles, with no gaps and no overlaps.

title: One square always left over
description: A 5 by 7 grid covered by 17 coloured 2 × 1 tiles with one vermilion square left over in the bottom right corner.

title: Even side or both odd?
description: Three grids in a row: a 6 by 4 grid tiled with vertical tiles, a 3 by 4 grid tiled with horizontal tiles, and an untiled 3 by 5 grid with a cross.

title: Count first, then tile
description: A heading, count the squares, branches to a 3 by 3 grid with one square left over and a 2 by 5 grid fully tiled with 5 vertical tiles.

topic_name: Missing Squares and the Colouring Argument
title: A 5 × 3 grid with the top right square removed
description: Show a 5 × 3 grid with its top right square removed, tiled with 7 tiles.

topic_name: Missing Squares and the Colouring Argument
title: Colouring the grid: 8 white and 6 black
description: Show a 5 × 3 grid coloured like a chessboard with the top middle square removed, and the colour counts.

topic_name: Missing Squares and the Colouring Argument
title: Count white, count black
description: A 4 by 4 chessboard with two white squares removed, a black and white example tile, and the tally white 6, black 8, 6 ≠ 8.

title: Three shapes that tile the plane
description: Show patches of square, equilateral triangle and regular hexagon tilings, with the angles at one corner.

title: A honeycomb tiling
description: Show a section of honeycomb, where bees tile space with regular hexagons and leave no gaps.

title: Angles that fill 360°
description: A three row table: a square with 90° × 4 = 360°, a triangle with 60° × 6 = 360°, and a hexagon with 120° × 3 = 360°.

title: Constructions and tilings
description: On the left, the perpendicular bisector of XY drawn with grey arcs and a reddish purple line; on the right, a 2 by 4 grid covered by four 2 × 1 tiles.
